note: Both sets cover the same four Table 6-2 properties and the 1% critical damping statement with largely correct values and quotes, and both are heavily padded with duplicate claims. Each set contains the same core errors: 38.234 m mislabeled as a distance/radius rather than the CM location, a damping claim with the condition inverted to 'rotor-nacelle assembly mass present' (the text says without it), an invented condition 'Height above Ground = 87.6 m' on the damping ratio, and a misread binding of 87.6 m to 'tower centerline height above ground' when it is the overall tower height. A adds only further redundant duplicates (and slightly altered quote punctuation), while B adds one extra valid damping restatement, leaving the two effectively equivalent in accuracy.
